/// <summary>
/// Composes a fake-backed ServiceProvider for LoadEmployeesPackage -- a fresh FakeUnitOfWork
/// per DI scope (so RunBranchAsync's own per-branch transactions are individually observable
/// -- see {Package}.cs's own concurrent-wave handling), a null logger for every ILogger&lt;T&gt;,
/// a fixed TimeProvider, and empty FileSourceOptions/DatabaseOptions/BulkCopyOptions (populated
/// for real once a testDataFiles entry exists). Every file-based source -- CSV, fixed-width,
/// Excel alike -- resolves through a package-relative TestData/ folder, the SAME folder
/// appsettings.Development.json points a real local run at (see the LOCAL-DATA work packet):
/// there is no separate, tool-synthesized fallback here, so a source's own read test needs
/// its real LOCAL-DATA fill applied before it can pass -- see EmitFileSourceTest's own doc
/// comment. No SQL Server involved anywhere by default: the DbContext
/// behind each FakeUnitOfWork is the real generated LoadEmployeesDbContext, configured with a
/// connection string that is NEVER opened -- EF only needs the model to answer schema/column
/// questions (see FakeUnitOfWork.BulkInsertAsync). NewRealUnitOfWorkAsync() is the one
/// deliberate opt-in exception -- see its own doc comment.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class PackageHarness : IDisposable
{
    private readonly ServiceProvider _root;

    /// <summary>The SAME DatabaseOptions the fake-backed ServiceProvider above was built
    /// from -- captured so NewRealUnitOfWorkAsync() reads whatever a human has pointed this
    /// at for a local Integration run (see that method's own doc comment) rather than a
    /// second, independent copy that could silently drift from the DI-registered one.</summary>
    private readonly DatabaseOptions _databaseOptions;

    /// <summary>A fresh, isolated temp folder for this harness instance's own Flat File
    /// Destination writes (a real IBulkSink&lt;T&gt; never touches IUnitOfWork -- see
    /// FlatFileBulkSink's own doc comment -- so there is nothing to fake; writing to a real,
    /// per-instance folder instead is what keeps a "Sink -- flat file" starter test isolated
    /// from every other test run, parallel or not). Deleted in Dispose.</summary>
    private readonly string _sinkOutputDirectory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "ssisx-tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));

    /// <summary>Every FakeUnitOfWork actually resolved from DI so far -- one per scope, so a
    /// concurrent wave's own per-branch transactions are each independently inspectable after
    /// RunAsync returns. A ConcurrentBag because a concurrent wave resolves more than one
    /// scope's own IUnitOfWork in parallel.</summary>
    public ConcurrentBag<FakeUnitOfWork> CreatedUnitsOfWork { get; } = [];

    public RecordingNotifier Notifier { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>Set before calling Package().RunAsync() to make the VERY NEXT
    /// FakeUnitOfWork resolved from DI throw this from GetBindTokenAsync -- the universal,
    /// package-shape-agnostic failure-injection point (see FakeUnitOfWork's own doc
    /// comment). Read at DI-resolution time, not at harness-construction time, so setting
    /// it any time before RunAsync() is called takes effect.</summary>
    public Exception? ThrowOnGetBindToken { get; set; }

    /// <param name="useSampleDataForFileSources">True ONLY for the happy-path RunAsync
    /// starter test, which runs the WHOLE pipeline (including a real CSV/fixed-width read)
    /// and so needs SOME parseable file even with no LOCAL-DATA fill supplied yet -- points
    /// every CSV/fixed-width source at the Tier-A synthetic sample (SampleData/) instead of
    /// the real TestData/ file. Every OTHER test (the isolated source-read Integration test
    /// included) leaves this false and gets the real TestData/ file, exactly as before.</param>
    public PackageHarness(bool useSampleDataForFileSources = false)
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton(typeof(ILogger<>), typeof(NullLogger<>));
        services.AddSingleton<TimeProvider>(new FixedTimeProvider(new DateTimeOffset(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero)));
        // ConnectTimeoutSeconds=1 -- a Lookup preload (LookupCache.LoadAsync) takes a raw
        // connection string, never IUnitOfWork, so it always attempts a REAL connection to
        // this fake server regardless of anything else being faked; the default 15s timeout
        // would make every Lookup-bearing package's RunAsync failure-path test that slow.
        _databaseOptions = new DatabaseOptions { Server = "(fake)", Database = "Fake", ConnectTimeoutSeconds = 1 };
        services.AddSingleton<IOptions<DatabaseOptions>>(Options.Create(_databaseOptions));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_sinkOutputDirectory);
        services.AddSingleton<IOptions<FileSourceOptions>>(Options.Create(new FileSourceOptions
        {
            Files =
            {
                ["Employee"] = useSampleDataForFileSources ? new FileSourceEntry { SourceFolder = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "SampleData"), SourceFileName = "Employee.csv" } : new FileSourceEntry { SourceFolder = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "TestData"), SourceFileName = "Employees.csv" },
            },
        }));
        services.AddSingleton<IOptions<BulkCopyOptions>>(Options.Create(new BulkCopyOptions()));
        services.AddSingleton<IPackageResultNotifier>(Notifier);
        services.AddScoped<IUnitOfWork>(_ =>
        {
            var uow = new FakeUnitOfWork(NewDbContext()) { ThrowOnGetBindToken = ThrowOnGetBindToken };
            CreatedUnitsOfWork.Add(uow);
            return uow;
        });

        _root = services.BuildServiceProvider();
    }

    /// <summary>A fresh package instance, backed by this harness's own ServiceProvider --
    /// calling RunAsync() resolves a NEW scoped IUnitOfWork/FakeUnitOfWork per DI scope,
    /// matching production wiring exactly (see LoadEmployeesPackage.RunAsync's own

    public LoadEmployeesPackage Package() => new(_root);

    /// <summary>A standalone FakeUnitOfWork for a step-level test that calls one internal
    /// method directly (e.g. `package.SQL_TruncateTargets(uow, ct)`) without ever going
    /// through RunAsync -- not tracked in CreatedUnitsOfWork, since it was never resolved
    /// from DI.</summary>
    public FakeUnitOfWork NewUnitOfWork() => new(NewDbContext());

    /// <summary>A REAL, already-begun UnitOfWork (not FakeUnitOfWork) -- only for a hand-run
    /// [Trait("Category", "Integration")] test against an actually reachable server (see
    /// Tools/COPILOT_TESTING_GUIDE.md's own "point this at a real server" section: edit the
    /// _databaseOptions line in this file's own constructor for a local run). A source that
    /// takes IUnitOfWork -- an OLE DB/ADO NET Source's own SqlRowSource -- always attempts
    /// sp_bindsession when given a non-null uow, and FakeUnitOfWork.GetBindTokenAsync always
    /// returns the same literal placeholder string, which any real server correctly rejects;
    /// only a genuine bind token (sp_getbindtoken, issued on THIS instance's own active
    /// transaction) satisfies that call. Begun here, not left to the caller, because
    /// production code never calls GetBindTokenAsync before BeginAsync either -- see
    /// UnitOfWork's own precondition on that method. Never committed, so its own transaction
    /// rolls back on disposal -- the caller owns disposal (`await using`), and a plain SELECT
    /// read leaves nothing to roll back anyway.</summary>
    public async Task<UnitOfWork> NewRealUnitOfWorkAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<LoadEmployeesDbContext>()
            .UseSqlServer(SqlConnectionStringFactory.Build(_databaseOptions))
            .Options;
        var uow = new UnitOfWork(new LoadEmployeesDbContext(options), new SqlBulkCopyFactory(), NullLogger<UnitOfWork>.Instance);
        await uow.BeginAsync(IsolationLevel.ReadCommitted, ct);
        return uow;
    }

    /// <summary>The real, resolved path a Flat File Destination method keyed by "key" writes
    /// to -- the SAME path the generated File(key) helper resolves via FileSourceOptions,
    /// computed here (not re-derived from a different formula) so a sink starter test can
    /// read the real file back after WriteAsync returns.</summary>
    public string SinkFilePath(string key) => Path.Combine(_sinkOutputDirectory, $"{key}.out.txt");

    /// <summary>The real, resolved path a File System Task method keyed by "key" reads its

    /// helper resolves via FileSourceOptions. A starter test writes the source file here
    /// before calling the method, then reads the destination file back from here
    /// afterward.</summary>
    public string FileSystemTaskPath(string key) => Path.Combine(_sinkOutputDirectory, $"{key}.fst.dat");

    /// <summary>The real, writable folder a ForEach Loop method keyed by "key" enumerates --
    /// the SAME folder the generated File(key) helper resolves via FileSourceOptions (a
    /// folder-only entry, empty SourceFileName). A starter test writes its own source files
    /// here before calling the method; created eagerly in the constructor (see above) since
    /// Directory.EnumerateFiles throws if the folder does not exist yet.</summary>
    public string ForEachLoopFolder(string key) => Path.Combine(_sinkOutputDirectory, key);

    private static LoadEmployeesDbContext NewDbContext()
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<LoadEmployeesDbContext>()
            .UseSqlServer("Server=(local);Database=Fake;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;")
            .Options;
        return new LoadEmployeesDbContext(options);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _root.Dispose();
        try { if (Directory.Exists(_sinkOutputDirectory)) Directory.Delete(_sinkOutputDirectory, recursive: true); }
        catch (IOException) { /* best-effort cleanup, not a test failure */ }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
    }

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTimeOffset now) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => now;
